translation: No, I do not speak Ga

word: Ofainɛ, tsɔ̃ɔ̃mɔ̃ mi bɔni awieɔ Ga
translation: Please teach me how to speak Ga

word: Obaanyɛ ni otsɔ̃ɔ̃ mi Ga wiemɔ̃?
Daabi, ŋyɛ̃ŋ mã tsɔ̃ɔ̃ bo Ga
translation: No, I can't teach you Ga

word: Hɛ̃ɛ̃, matsɔ̃ɔ̃ bo bɔni awieɔ Ga
translation: Yes, I will teach you how to speak Ga

word: Yɛ Nyɔ̃ŋmɔ dromɔ nãa ŋyɛ jogbaŋŋ

translation: Which tribe do you belong to?

word: Ŋye afii nyɔ̃ŋmãi enyɔ̃ kɛ ekpaa
Ŋye afii nyɔ̃ŋmãi ekpaa kɛ nɛ̃ɛ̃hu
Ŋfeɔ Youtube videos, ni Nikaselɔ hu jimi
translation: I create YouTube videos, and I am also a student

word: Ŋyɛ hejɔɔmɔ mli shi ŋfeɔ Youtube videos
translation: I am retired, but I create YouTube videos
What do you do for fun?

word: Ŋboɔ radio toi ni ŋkwɛɔ TV
translation: I listen to the radio and watch TV
No, I don't go on Facebook
But I like looking at pictures
Do you keep some animals at home?

word: Ŋyɛ gbee kome kɛ alɔntei ejwɛ
translation: I have one dog and four cats
I have some chickens at home
This Christmas I'm throwing a party
What would you like me to do?
Shall I bring some of my chickens?
No, the food will be too much
Please give me your phone number
I wake up at 5:00 am every day
Firstly, I go to the toilet
I wipe myself with a towel

word: Ŋkwɛɔ aiŋshwɛ/ashwishwɛ mli kɛ shɛɔ ŋtsɛ̃ŋ
translation: I look into the mirror to shave my beard
I apply lotion to my body

word: Kɛkɛɛ, ŋtee kpataashi ŋyahoo leebi niyenii
translation: Then, I go to the kitchen to prepare breakfast

word: Ŋhoɔ akasã ni ŋkɛ blodo kɛ butru nuɔ̃
translation: I cook porridge and eat it with bread and butter

word: No sɛɛ, ŋshiɔ̃ shiã leebi ŋmɛjii ekpaa
translation: After that, I leave the house at 6:00 am

word: Ŋmɛ̃ɔ trɔtrɔ ni kɛmi yaa nikasemɔ̃he ɛ
translation: I wait for a trotro which takes me to school

word: Kɛ mii ya nikasemɔ̃he ɛ, ŋkwɛɔ adafii ni atswaa yɛ ŋfone ɛ nɔ̃
translation: On my way to school, I watch the news on my phone

word: Leebi titri ji mi nikasemɔ̃ bei
translation: Most of my classes are in the morning

word: Kɛ ŋkpa nikasemɔ̃ɔ̃ ŋyeɔ bei ni eshwɛ ɛ, yɛ wolotoohe we ɛ
translation: After class, I spend the day in the library
In the afternoon, I buy food

word: Ŋtsakɛɔ ŋniyeniŋ ɛ̃ mli kɛ fufui kɛ wonu aloo amãdãŋ tsuru kɛ yɔɔ aloo jɔlɔf
translation: I alternate between fufu and soup, plantain and beans, and jollof

word: Ŋshiɔ̃ nikasemɔ̃ we ɛ gbɛkɛ ŋmɛjii ejwɛ
Daa Hɔɔ ɔ, ŋkudɔɔ ŋtsɔ̃ne kɛyaa nitsumɔ̃
translation: On Saturdays, I drive to work

word: Ŋboɔ radio toi yɛ tsɔ̃ne ɛ mli
translation: In the car, I listen to the radio

word: Kɛ ŋshɛ nitsimɔ he ɛ pɛ, kɛkɛ ŋsu ŋlaptop ɛ
translation: Once in the office, I turn on my laptop

word: Ŋkwɛɔ wodzi ni a ŋmãŋmai ɛ̃ ni ŋhãã amɛ hetoi
translation: I check my inbox and respond to emails

word: Dãni mãye shwãne niyenii ɛ̃, ŋsaa ŋvideos ɛ ŋtɔɔ
translation: Before my lunch, I prepare my videos

word: Ŋkɔɔ shwãne hejɔɔmɔ̃ bee koni ŋkɛ mãini ŋkɛ tsuɔ̃nii ɛ̃ aya yenii
translation: I take a lunch break and eat with my colleagues

word: Kɛ ŋkpa, ŋshɛɔ shi gbɛkɛ ŋmɛjii ekpaa
translation: When I finish work, I get home at 6 pm

word: Ŋyafɔɔ ŋde, kɛ ŋshɛ shiã nɔ̃ŋŋ pɛ
translation: I wash my hands as soon as I arrive home

word: Mi diɛŋtsɛ, ŋfeɔ ŋshiã nitsumɔ̃i ɛ̃
Ŋnãã hoɔ niyenii ɛ̃ ni miŋmɛ̃ɔ okplɔ̃ɔ̃
translation: My grandma cooks and I lay the table

word: Wɔ kwɛɔ TV yɛ asaaanɔ̃, kɛ etɔko wɔ
translation: We watch TV in the living room if we're not tired

word: Beikomɛ̃i ɛ̃, ŋsumɔ̃ɔ̃ mãkãne nii dãni mãwɔ
translation: Sometimes, I like to read before sleeping

word: Ŋkwɛɔ Youtube yɛ ŋfon ɛ̃ nɔ̃ kɛ ŋkã saa nɔ̃
translation: I watch YouTube on my phone when I'm on the bed
